notes.title: Ace Combat 7 gets a free birthday update (and we miss you, JPEG Dog)
notes.notes:
Time sure... flies, huh? Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown is now two years old, and to celebrate, publisher Bandai Namco has a free update on the way that adds a selection of free new content to the arcade-style flight simulation game.
What Ace Combat 7 pilots will be seeing when the update drops January 19 is a bundle of new skins and emblems for their aircraft. There's a Phoenix skin for the F-22A, a Mobius skin for the F-4E, Garuda for the F-15E Strike Eagle, Rodgebacks for the ASF-X Shinden II, a Crow skin for the F-16C Fighting Falcon, Scarface and UPEO skins for the Su-37, Gryphus for the F-22A Raptor, UPEO for the Typhoon, and a eye-melting glowing skin for the X-02S Strike Wyvern.
On top of that, you'll also be getting a new batch of emblems for use on your aircraft, one of which is Trigger's distinctive orange wolf carrying a revolver in its mouth. That's all well and good, but we choose to believe that Trigger's mascot is actually the legendary JPEG Dog, a dearly departed golden retriever who had belonged to one of the developers.
Read the rest of the story...

In celebration of the 25th anniversary of the ACE COMBAT™ series, the additional downloadable content "25th Anniversary DLC - Original Aircraft Series" is coming out tomorrow!

This DLC includes three of the most popular aircraft from the series, the ASF-X Shinden II, XFA-27, and CFA-44 Nosferatu, along with new weapons, skins, and emblems.

Content:

 3 playable aircraft
- CFA-44 Nosferatu　
- XFA-27

- Special skin and special armor for each aircraft

 12 aircraft skins are available: F-15C Eagle Cipher Skin", "Rafale M Espada Skin" etc. from ACE COMBAT ZERO THE BELKAN WAR

notes.title: ACE COMBAT 7: SKIES UNKNOWN Patch 1.10
notes.notes:
A new update has been released for ACE COMBAT 7: SKIES UNKNOWN!
Patch 1.10 implements the following improvements:


 Changed the special weapon ammo capacity for certain aircraft.
The affected weapons for each aircraft are as follows:

- F-15C:                   PLSL
- MiG-31B:                PLSL

- F-2A:                     HVAA
- YF-23:                   HVAA
- Su-33:                    HVAA

- F-104C:                  SAAM
- F-15J:                    SAAM
- MiG-21bis:             SAAM
- MiG-31B:               SAAM
- Su-47:                    SAAM

- F-14D:                   LAAM
- Rafale M:               LAAM
- Typhoon:               LAAM
- MiG-31B:               LAAM
- Su-35S:                 LAAM

 Increased the capabilities of certain special weapons in multiplayer mode.
The affected weapons are as follows:

- HVAA
- LAAM
- 4AAM
- 6AAM
- 8AAM

 Reduced the flight distance for certain special weapons in multiplayer.
The affected weapons are as follows:

- QAAM

 Increased the capabilities of certain upgrade parts.
The affected parts are as follows:

- Bulletproof Fuel Tank Lv. 1
- Bulletproof Fuel Tank Lv. 2
- Directional Proximity Fuze (SP.W) Lv. 2

 Fixed an issue in which MGP rounds would become invisible in certain places during multiplayer.
 Fixed an issue in which "Lost" would display to the team that won a Team Death Match when certain conditions had been met during multiplayer.
 Improved load times on the peripheral selection screen of the PC version when multiple peripherals were connected. 
 Changed the connectivity restrictions for certain accessories.
Please contact the manufacturers of any accessories you own if you have inquiries regarding their operation.
 Added Latin American Spanish to the language dropdown prior to launching the game. Please check the language setting within the game's properties to ensure the desired language is selected.
 Fixed other minor issues.


Read the full patch notes: http://bnent.eu/AC7Patch110
